baseline_requirement: Ingest time-series manufacturing telemetry with source timestamps and quality flags
reference_check: Sample records validate; BAD/missing observations retain declared provenance; invalid batches are not published
remaining_acceptance: Authorize real source; verify physical timestamps, units, quality flags and buffering

baseline_requirement: Ingest production orders, runs, campaigns, recipes and changeovers
rationale: Relate observations to orders and changes
reference_check: Schema definition exists; no production order/run ingestion acceptance claimed
remaining_acceptance: Implement source adapter and order/run/campaign/recipe/changeover mappings with accepted source records

baseline_requirement: Associate material lots/batches with production events
reference_check: Contracts expose material linkage; nullable sample links are not reconstructed genealogy
remaining_acceptance: Obtain lot/event identifiers; implement joins and evaluate missing/ambiguous associations

baseline_requirement: Ingest quality, laboratory, dimensional and inspection results
reference_check: Sample quality outputs validate; unknown disposition remains unknown
remaining_acceptance: Qualify actual laboratory/inspection sources, methods, limits and disposition semantics

baseline_requirement: Create end-to-end material/product genealogy
stakeholder_need: SR-01; SR-04: material loss and containment
rationale: Identify downstream exposure from evidenced links
reference_check: Supplied directed edges require evidence and reject reachable cycles
remaining_acceptance: No end-to-end plant genealogy service or source completeness proof; validate actual lot/run/product coverage

baseline_requirement: Calculate process-health and stability indicators
reference_check: Reference mean/standard deviation and illustrative three-sigma checks execute on finite input
remaining_acceptance: Approve process-specific limits; validate applicability; reference function is not Xbar-R process validation

baseline_requirement: Calculate calibrated quality-risk estimates
reference_check: Reference logistic path computes calibration metrics; no accepted field probability claim
remaining_acceptance: SECOM independent confirmation remains pending; Lenze IsolationForest scores are not calibrated quality probabilities

baseline_requirement: Calculate yield/scrap risk estimates
reference_check: Architecture intent only; anomaly classification does not establish yield/scrap prediction
remaining_acceptance: Define yield/scrap targets, source timing, model and acceptance criteria

baseline_requirement: Detect multivariate anomalies and change points
reference_check: Frozen publisher test: recall 208/320 >= 0.50; false alerts/all rows 122/1576 <= 0.10; strict score > frozen cutoff
remaining_acceptance: No dedicated change-point acceptance or live process validation; weak labels and precomputed features limit scope

baseline_requirement: Detect process and data drift
reference_check: Reference shift/envelope indicators execute; provisional thresholds remain labeled
remaining_acceptance: Approve site drift policy and validate detection latency, false alarms and response

baseline_requirement: Explain primary contributors to each material prediction
reference_check: Reference logistic path returns ranked calibrated-log-odds contributions and association-only scope
remaining_acceptance: Does not explain each Lenze prediction or establish causal effects; validate operator usefulness

baseline_requirement: Correlate equipment condition with process and quality outcomes
stakeholder_need: Maintenance/quality: relate asset condition and quality
reference_check: Architecture defines intended relationship
remaining_acceptance: Implement joined asset/quality analysis and validate correlation under timing/confounding constraints

baseline_requirement: Associate maintenance interventions with subsequent behavior
rationale: Relate interventions to subsequent process behavior
reference_check: Sample failure events map to a maintenance contract; this is not observed maintenance intervention effectiveness
remaining_acceptance: Acquire actual intervention chronology and post-intervention outcomes; failure labels do not establish maintenance actions

baseline_requirement: Reconstruct historical production trajectories
reference_check: Sample data runs have content-derived identity and validated replay
remaining_acceptance: Full production trajectory needs real run/material/equipment joins and physical time alignment

baseline_requirement: Retrieve comparable historical events
reference_check: Numeric nearest-case retrieval excludes records at or after the as-of boundary
remaining_acceptance: Validate relevance, historical coverage, outcome-availability timing and analyst effort on intended cases

baseline_requirement: Generate evidence-supported root-cause hypotheses
reference_check: Associative explanations and retrieval are inputs; an accepted root-cause hypothesis service is not implemented
remaining_acceptance: Implement evidence attribution and uncertainty; validate hypotheses with process expertise

baseline_requirement: Estimate intervention outcomes using counterfactual methods
reference_check: Counterfactual methods are design intent only
remaining_acceptance: Define interventions, causal assumptions, identification and independent validation

baseline_requirement: Support validated digital-twin simulation
reference_check: Composable twin is an architectural decision; no validated twin deployed
remaining_acceptance: Build and validate bounded simulation including uncertainty and intended-use limits

baseline_requirement: Trace downstream material potentially affected by an excursion
rationale: Find descendants without inventing missing links
reference_check: Traversal reports supplied_edges_only coverage and rejects invalid genealogy
remaining_acceptance: Establish authoritative graph completeness and containment-time criteria on actual material

baseline_requirement: Provide role-appropriate alerts and risk views
reference_check: Reference alert counts and health events exist; threshold denominator is explicit
remaining_acceptance: Role-specific UI, authorization, actionability, paging delivery and human acceptance remain incomplete

baseline_requirement: Support approve/modify/reject human dispositions
reference_check: Local ledger accepts APPROVE/MODIFY/REJECT/INVESTIGATE with actor and rationale; review does not authorize control
remaining_acceptance: Implement authenticated multi-user workflow and evaluate actual operators

baseline_requirement: Record human disposition and realized outcome
stakeholder_need: Governance/process learning: connect decisions to outcomes
reference_check: Local disposition is recorded; outcome contract exists
remaining_acceptance: Persist and verify realized outcomes and their identity/timing; real operational outcomes are absent

baseline_requirement: Preserve model, feature and data lineage
rationale: Connect source, model and feature versions
reference_check: Frozen source/model hashes, feature order and decision digest identify reference artifacts
remaining_acceptance: Upstream extraction formulas, units, windows and physical point-in-time provenance remain unverified

baseline_requirement: Support deterministic model rollback
reference_check: Local registry switches to previous verified bundle; separate Lenze drill restores identical frozen artifacts in eight cases
remaining_acceptance: Cloud object restore and active deployed service rollback remain unverified

baseline_requirement: Detect model drift and calibration degradation
rationale: Observe changing input and labeled performance
reference_check: Reference health/shift/performance calculations exist; labels are required for observed performance
remaining_acceptance: Live label linkage, probability-calibration monitoring and end-to-end alert response remain open

baseline_requirement: Persist evidence package for each recommendation
reference_check: Reference evidence identifiers and local persistence exist
remaining_acceptance: No production recommendation service; complete evidence retention, authentication and outcome linkage need validation

baseline_requirement: Provide plant/line/run/material/product views
reference_check: Domain/view requirements defined; production views not implemented
remaining_acceptance: Implement entity mapping and role-specific views; evaluate intended users

baseline_requirement: Support multimodal inspection as an extension point
rationale: Preserve an extension path without asserting delivery
reference_check: Future extension; no multimodal runtime acceptance
remaining_acceptance: Define approved use case, contracts, fusion approach and validation before implementation

baseline_requirement: Represent relationships in an industrial knowledge graph
reference_check: Explicit-edge traversal does not constitute an industrial knowledge-graph service
remaining_acceptance: Define graph semantics, persistence, query behavior and coverage verification

baseline_requirement: Enforce separation between advisory AI and safety/control authority
rationale: Prevent reference analysis from granting plant control
reference_check: Reference activation restricts mode to SHADOW; authority is ABSTAIN; production gate remains BLOCKED even with flags
remaining_acceptance: Reference boundary implemented; revalidate all paths and physical isolation before site integration

baseline_requirement: Loss of AI shall not stop basic plant operation.
rationale: Keep AI outside the essential plant control chain
reference_check: Documented advisory/degraded boundary; no plant dependency exists in current scope
remaining_acceptance: Demonstrate loss-of-AI behavior during eventual site integration

baseline_requirement: AI shall never bypass existing safety controls or interlocks.
reference_check: Reference code does not grant control authority
remaining_acceptance: Actual interlock/control interface and hazard review require site integration evidence

baseline_requirement: Risk scoring shall meet the agreed process-response window.
rationale: Match decision timing to useful intervention window
reference_check: No invented process-response target; manual batch timing is not plant latency acceptance
remaining_acceptance: Specify percentile, load, measurement boundary and required process-response window

baseline_requirement: The system shall degrade safely when data or dependencies fail.
rationale: Refuse invalid input or corrupted dependencies
reference_check: Reference invalid-input and artifact-refusal paths are implemented
remaining_acceptance: Exercise reference cloud dependency failures and validate intended site degraded behavior

baseline_requirement: Operational recommendations shall include interpretable evidence.
reference_check: Reference logistic associations carry model/feature identity and non-causal scope
remaining_acceptance: Validate explanation coverage for chosen runtime and comprehension by intended users

baseline_requirement: Predictions shall link to source data, feature set, code and model version.
reference_check: Frozen artifact and per-record decision identity retained
remaining_acceptance: Complete raw-to-feature lineage and traceable production configuration/outcomes

baseline_requirement: OT integration shall use segmented least-privilege pathways.
reference_check: IaC disables public data-plane access and scopes job identities; private reference access is recorded
remaining_acceptance: OT segmentation, enterprise identity and full least-privilege assurance require review and eventual site tests

baseline_requirement: Manufacturing evidence shall be protected from unauthorized alteration.
rationale: Detect substitution and prevent uncontrolled changes
reference_check: Checksums and hash-chain consistency detect tested modifications
remaining_acceptance: Hashes are not authenticated signatures or immutable storage; verify access, anchors, retention and cloud recovery

baseline_requirement: Human and machine decisions shall be logged and attributable.
reference_check: Local ledger requires actor string and rationale and records hash-linked events
remaining_acceptance: Authenticate actors; enforce roles, retention and tamper-resistant persistence; actor string is not identity proof

baseline_requirement: Architecture shall scale across additional assets, lines and plants.
rationale: Design for growth with bounded cost/performance
reference_check: Sizing dimensions documented; no measured multi-site capacity acceptance
remaining_acceptance: Measure workloads and scaling/isolation behavior against agreed targets

baseline_requirement: Interfaces shall minimize machine-vendor and cloud-provider coupling.
reference_check: Canonical schemas and multiple sample adapters exist
remaining_acceptance: Production interface compatibility and vendor/cloud portability are not established by sample adapters

baseline_requirement: Data, service and model health shall be measurable end-to-end.
reference_check: Structured health events and monitoring configuration are prepared/tested as recorded
remaining_acceptance: Prepared monitoring changes are not deployed; verify persisted telemetry, query path, paging and response

baseline_requirement: Critical services shall support deterministic restore/rollback.
rationale: Recover accepted artifacts and service behavior
reference_check: Eight local artifact restoration cases recorded; source release unchanged
remaining_acceptance: Cloud restore, deployed rollback and approved RPO/RTO remain unverified

baseline_requirement: Schemas, pipelines, code and models shall be independently versioned.
reference_check: Schema/code/source/model identities exist; feature catalog is retrospective
remaining_acceptance: Complete compatibility/migration policy, named ownership and upgrade evidence

baseline_requirement: Core models/contracts shall not depend on one equipment vendor.
rationale: Keep source semantics separate from execution provider
reference_check: Recorded Windows/Linux/Azure decision consistency for one frozen model
remaining_acceptance: Cross-equipment and cross-site generalization remain unverified; OS replay is not domain portability

baseline_requirement: Stale, missing, duplicated, misordered or invalid telemetry shall be identified.
reference_check: Sample duplicate/schema/order checks and reference shadow freshness checks exist
remaining_acceptance: Qualify actual sensor semantics and freshness policy; do not attribute shadow checks automatically to Lenze batch

baseline_requirement: Alerting shall be managed by severity, budget and actionability.
reference_check: Reference false alerts/all rows <= 0.10; measured 122/1576
remaining_acceptance: Severity, operator workload, actionability and site-approved alert budget remain unvalidated

baseline_requirement: Cross-system time shall support reliable event reconstruction.
reference_check: Timestamp syntax/order checks exist and source adapters disclose time assumptions
remaining_acceptance: Establish physical clock synchronization, event availability, uncertainty and source-to-source alignment

baseline_requirement: Model promotion shall require pre-defined evidence gates.
rationale: Prevent benchmark success from granting production authority
reference_check: Fixed reference criteria and hard production refusal implemented
remaining_acceptance: Production release authority, independently reviewed evidence and protected promotion workflow remain absent

baseline_requirement: AI failure shall revert to existing approved operating procedures.
reference_check: Reference shadow path abstains from plant recommendations; no plant fallback execution claimed
remaining_acceptance: Validate actual procedures, operator readiness and failure transitions with an authorized site
